teachers.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
teachers.message: To my dear Sec-D students: teaching you algorithms and systems has been an absolute privilege. Always remain curious, solve problems with empathy, and never stop learning.

teachers.name: Prof. Elena Rostova
teachers.message: Thank you for putting together such a magical, thoughtful Teachers' Day. Seeing your dedication today makes me confident that the future of technology is in wonderful hands.

teachers.name: Prof. Marcus Vance
teachers.message: The handwritten notes and custom Memory Book are treasures I will keep forever. Keep striving for excellence, Sec-D!

apology.label: ONE LAST PAGE
apology.title: From Our Hearts
paragraphs: We tried to preserve every smile, every laugh, and every little moment that made this Teachers' Day so special to all of us.
If something doesn't work perfectly or if we missed a detail, we sincerely apologize. We may not have captured every single angle, but we gave this tribute our absolute best.
apology.subSignature: Made with love by CSE Sec-D Students

memories.message: Prof. Elena's lecture on neural networks changed how I view computer science forever. Happy Teachers' Day to the absolute best faculty!
Dr. Thorne's patience during final project reviews was legendary. Thank you for guiding us through every bug and concept!
Section D wouldn't be Section D without Prof. Marcus's architecture drills. We are who we are because of your relentless encouragement.
